title.zh: 修订第 7303 号共和国法规定的 Kalayaan 广播系统公司特许权并为其他目的法案
title.en: An Act Amending the Franchise of Kalayaan Broadcasting System, Incorporated, Provided Under Republic Act Numbered Seventy-three Hundred and Three, and for Other Purposes
title.orig: An Act Amending the Franchise of Kalayaan Broadcasting System, Incorporated, Provided Under Republic Act Numbered Seventy-three Hundred and Three, and for Other Purposes

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1995/ra_8105_1995.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。 源文条号不连续（自第 1 条起，止于第 12 条，缺 5、6、7、8、9、10、11）：经逐条比对原始页面，该处原文没有对应的 “Section N.” 抬头行，系来源页自身的编号跳跃或条文以“续段”形式并入前条，非抽取遗漏，故未擅自补号。 源文存在同号重出的条款（第 1 条）：该处官方页面确有两段均标同一 Section 号，本库照录其 `no` 值（不改动官方编号），条文 `id` 以 `_2`「_3」后缀保证唯一。

text.en:
Section 1 of Republic Act Numbered Seventy-three hundred and three is hereby amended to read as follows:
"

Nature and Scope of Franchise. - Subject to the provisions of the Constitution and applicable laws, rules and regulations, there is hereby granted to the Kalayaan Broadcasting System, Incorporated, hereunder referred to as the grantee, its successors or assigns, a franchise to construct, install, operate and maintain for commercial purposes and in the public interest radio broadcasting and television stations in the island of Mindanao with the corresponding technological auxiliaries or facilities, special broadcast and other program and distribution services and relay stations, and to install radio communication and television facilities for the grantee's private use in its broadcast activities."

A new section is hereby inserted between Sections 11 and 12 of Republic Act No. 7303, and denominated as Section 12, to read as follows, thereafter the succeeding sections are renumbered:
"

Self-regulation by and Undertaking of Grantee. - The grantee shall not require any prior censorship in any speech, play, act or scene, or other matter to be broadcast or telecast from its station: Provided, That the grantee, during any broadcast or telecast, may cut off from the air any speech, play, act or scene or other matter being broadcast or telecast if the tendency thereof is to propose and/or incite treason, rebellion or sedition, or the language used therein is indecent or immoral and willful failure to do so shall constitute a valid cause for the cancellation of this franchise."
The succeeding sections are hereby renumbered accordingly.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days from the date of its publication in at least two (2) newspapers of general circulation in the Philippines.
